analysis.reasonEn: Buy decision maintained for 2 consecutive sessions (Aug 12, 2026, Aug 13, 2026). RSI moved from 48.8 to 55.0, exiting oversold and settling into neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from 2.2840 to 5.9706, indicating bullish expansion. The Higher Low pattern persists, with the 5-day low ($529.39) higher than the 20-day low ($464.08). Weekly RSI at 61.3 signals entry into a bullish zone. ADX at 17.9 suggests a lack of established trend, but daily indicators show alignment.
